ledger.x: 1918, September: the Serbian army's liberation of Vardar Macedonia.
1918, 14-15 September: the French and Serbian assault at Dobro Pole.
1918, 30 September: the Macedonian front ends at noon ('On 29 September the Bulgarians were granted the Armistice of Salonica'; 'The Macedonian front ended at noon on 30 September 1918').
1918, 1 December: Serbia ends in the Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes.

wars.name: Macedonian front (Vardar offensive of September 1918)
wars.outcome: The Allied offensive of September 1918 (bombardment from 14 September; 'the following day, the French and Serbians attacked and captured their objective' at Dobro Pole) broke the Bulgarian line; 'By 29 September (a day before Bulgaria exited World War I)…
